import * as pdfjs from "./lib/pdf.mjs";
import { boxesToMd } from "./layout.js";
import { fixText, shapesFromOps, UNKNOWN } from "./math.js";
import { classifyGlyph } from "./glyph.js";
pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "lib/pdf.worker.mjs";
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const dl = (name, data, type = "text/plain") => { const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data], { type })); a.download = name; a.click(); };

// tabs
[["t1","s1"],["t3","s3"]].forEach(([t,s]) => $(t).onclick = () => {
  ["t1","t3"].forEach(x => $(x).classList.toggle("on", x === t));
  ["s1","s3"].forEach(x => $(x).classList.toggle("hide", x !== s));
});
function wireDrop(d, f, fn) {
  d.onclick = () => f.click();
  f.onchange = () => f.files[0] && fn(f.files[0]);
  d.ondragover = e => { e.preventDefault(); d.classList.add("h"); };
  d.ondragleave = () => d.classList.remove("h");
  d.ondrop = e => { e.preventDefault(); d.classList.remove("h"); e.dataTransfer.files[0] && fn(e.dataTransfer.files[0]); };
}

/* ---------- PDF → Markdown ---------- */
let ocrWorker;
async function getOCR() {
  if (ocrWorker) return ocrWorker;
  const base = chrome.runtime.getURL("lib");
  ocrWorker = await Tesseract.createWorker("eng", 1, { workerPath: base + "/worker.min.js", corePath: base, langPath: base, workerBlobURL: false, gzip: true });
  return ocrWorker;
}
async function ocrCanvas(c) {
  const d = (await (await getOCR()).recognize(c)).data, boxes = [];
  for (const ln of d.lines || []) for (const w of ln.words || []) {
    if (!w.text.trim() || w.confidence < 25) continue;
    boxes.push({ x0: w.bbox.x0, x1: w.bbox.x1, y: -ln.bbox.y1, h: Math.max(1, ln.bbox.y1 - ln.bbox.y0), s: w.text });
  }
  return boxes.length ? boxesToMd(boxes, { tables: $("tbl").checked, cols: $("cols").checked, headings: false }) : d.text.trim();
}
let cancelled = false;
function parsePages(s, n) {
  s = (s || "").trim(); if (!s) return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  const set = new Set();
  for (const p of s.split(",")) { const m = p.trim().match(/^(\d+)(?:\s*-\s*(\d+))?$/); if (!m) continue; let x = +m[1], y = +(m[2] || m[1]); if (x > y) [x, y] = [y, x]; for (let i = Math.max(1, x); i <= Math.min(n, y); i++) set.add(i); }
  return [...set].sort((p, q) => p - q);
}
function setProg(f) { $("pw").classList.toggle("hide", f == null); $("pb").style.width = (f || 0) * 100 + "%"; }
function stats() { const t = $("out").value.length; $("stat").textContent = t ? `${t.toLocaleString()} chars · ≈${Math.round(t / 4).toLocaleString()} tokens` : ""; }

/* ---------- page raster (glyph shape classifier + figure crops) ---------- */
const GS = 4;
async function pageCanvas(page) {
  const vp = page.getViewport({ scale: GS }), c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = Math.ceil(vp.width); c.height = Math.ceil(vp.height);
  await page.render({ canvasContext: c.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true }), viewport: vp }).promise; return { c, vp };
}
const toBlob = c => new Promise(r => c.toBlob(r, "image/png"));
let figZip = null;
async function convert(file) {
  const st = $("st"), pdf = await pdfjs.getDocument({ data: await file.arrayBuffer() }).promise;
  const nums = parsePages($("pages").value, pdf.numPages); if (!nums.length) throw new Error("No valid pages in that range");
  cancelled = false; $("cancel").classList.remove("hide"); const pages = [], t0 = Date.now(); let ocrN = 0, unk = 0, nFig = 0; figZip = null;
  try {
    for (let k = 0; k < nums.length && !cancelled; k++) {
      const n = nums[k]; st.textContent = `Page ${n} · ${k + 1}/${nums.length}`; setProg(k / nums.length);
      const page = await pdf.getPage(n), tc = await page.getTextContent();
      let shapes = null, fname = () => "";
      try {                                                    // operator list: loads fonts (real names) + gives fraction bars / radical signs
        const ol = await page.getOperatorList();
        fname = id => { try { return page.commonObjs.get(id)?.name || ""; } catch { return ""; } };
        shapes = shapesFromOps(ol, pdfjs.OPS, page.view[2] - page.view[0], page.view[3] - page.view[1]);
      } catch (e) { console.warn("shapes failed", e); }
      let boxes = tc.items.filter(i => i.str.trim() || /[\uf8e0-\uf8ff]/.test(i.str)).map(i => ({ x0: i.transform[4], x1: i.transform[4] + i.width, y: i.transform[5], h: Math.abs(i.transform[3]) || i.height || 10, s: fixText(i.str, fname(i.fontName)), w: i.width }));
      const figs = $("figs").value === "off" || !shapes ? [] : shapes.figs;
      if (!figs.length && shapes) shapes.figs = [];
      let R = null;
      // glyphs with no Unicode (custom-encoded symbol fonts): identify by their rendered shape
      const unkB = boxes.filter(b => b.s === UNKNOWN);
      if (unkB.length || figs.length) { try { R = await pageCanvas(page); } catch (e) { console.warn("raster failed", e); } }
      if (R && unkB.length) {
        const ctx = R.c.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });
        for (const b of unkB) {
          const [X0, Y0] = R.vp.convertToViewportPoint(b.x0 - 0.6, b.y + 0.95 * b.h), [X1, Y1] = R.vp.convertToViewportPoint(b.x1 + 0.6, b.y - 0.3 * b.h);
          const x = Math.floor(Math.min(X0, X1)), y = Math.floor(Math.min(Y0, Y1)), w = Math.ceil(Math.abs(X1 - X0)), h = Math.ceil(Math.abs(Y1 - Y0));
          if (w < 3 || h < 3) continue; const d = ctx.getImageData(Math.max(0, x), Math.max(0, y), w, h), r = classifyGlyph(d.data, d.width, d.height); if (r) b.s = r;
        }
      }
      // figures / graphs: pull their labels out of the text flow, leave a marker, optionally export a PNG crop
      for (const [fi, g] of figs.entries()) {
        const inside = boxes.filter(b => b.s.length <= 14 && (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2 >= g.x0 && (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2 <= g.x1 && b.y >= g.y0 - 2 && b.y <= g.y1 + 2);
        const set = new Set(inside); boxes = boxes.filter(b => !set.has(b));
        const name = `figure_p${n}_${fi + 1}.png`; let ref = "";
        if ($("figs").value === "export" && R) {
          const [A, B] = R.vp.convertToViewportPoint(g.x0 - 4, g.y1 + 4), [C, D] = R.vp.convertToViewportPoint(g.x1 + 4, g.y0 - 4);
          const cc = document.createElement("canvas"); cc.width = Math.ceil(C - A); cc.height = Math.ceil(D - B); cc.getContext("2d").drawImage(R.c, A, B, cc.width, cc.height, 0, 0, cc.width, cc.height);
          (figZip ||= new JSZip()).file(name, await toBlob(cc)); ref = name + " — ";
        }
        const labels = inside.sort((a, b) => b.y - a.y || a.x0 - b.x0).map(b => b.s).join(" ");
        boxes.push({ x0: g.x0, x1: g.x1, y: g.y1, h: 12, s: `[${g.kind === "graph" ? "Graph (axes detected)" : g.kind === "image" ? "Image" : "Figure"}: ${ref}labels: ${labels || "none"}]`, fig: true });
      }
      let md = boxesToMd(boxes, { tables: $("tbl").checked, cols: $("cols").checked, headings: true, math: $("math").value, shapes });
      unk += md.split(UNKNOWN).length - 1; nFig += figs.length;
      if (md.replace(/\s/g, "").length < 20 && $("ocr").checked) {
        st.textContent = `OCR page ${n} · ${k + 1}/${nums.length}`; ocrN++;
        const vp = page.getViewport({ scale: 3 }), c = document.createElement("canvas");
        c.width = vp.width; c.height = vp.height;
        await page.render({ canvasContext: c.getContext("2d"), viewport: vp }).promise;
        md = await ocrCanvas(c);
      }
      pages.push(`<!-- p.${n} -->\n${md}`);
    }
  } finally { $("cancel").classList.add("hide"); setProg(null); }
  $("out").value = `<!-- ${file.name} -->\n\n` + pages.join("\n\n---\n\n");
  st.textContent = `${cancelled ? "Stopped" : "Done"} — ${pages.length} page${pages.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}${ocrN ? `, ${ocrN} via OCR` : ""}${nFig ? `, ${nFig} figure${nFig === 1 ? "" : "s"}/graph${nFig === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : ""}${unk ? `, ⚠ ${unk} unreadable glyph${unk === 1 ? "" : "s"} marked ${UNKNOWN}` : ""}, ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`;
  $("fz").classList.toggle("hide", !figZip); mdChunks(); toast(cancelled ? "Stopped — partial result kept" : "Converted");
}
async function ocrImage(file) {
  $("st").textContent = "OCR…";
  const bmp = await createImageBitmap(file), sc = bmp.width < 1200 ? 2 : 1, c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = bmp.width * sc; c.height = bmp.height * sc; c.getContext("2d").drawImage(bmp, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
  $("out").value = `<!-- ${file.name} (OCR) -->\n\n` + (await ocrCanvas(c));
  $("st").textContent = "Done"; mdChunks(); toast("Converted");
}
wireDrop($("d1"), $("f1"), f => (f.type.startsWith("image/") ? ocrImage(f) : convert(f)).catch(e => $("st").textContent = "Error: " + e.message));
$("cp").onclick = async () => { await navigator.clipboard.writeText($("out").value); toast("Copied all"); };
$("fz").onclick = async () => { if (figZip) dl("figures.zip", await figZip.generateAsync({ type: "blob" }), "application/zip"); };
$("dl").onclick = () => dl("output.md", $("out").value, "text/markdown");

/* ---------- chunk list + insert into other tab ---------- */
const tabSel = $("tab");
async function loadTabs() {
  const me = (await chrome.tabs.getCurrent())?.id;
  const ts = (await chrome.tabs.query({})).filter(t => t.id !== me && /^https?:/.test(t.url || "")).sort((a, b) => (b.lastAccessed || 0) - (a.lastAccessed || 0));
  tabSel.replaceChildren(...ts.map(t => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = t.id; o.textContent = (t.title || t.url).slice(0, 60); return o; }));
}
$("rt").onclick = loadTabs; loadTabs();

async function insertInto(text) {
  const id = +tabSel.value; if (!id) throw new Error("Pick a target tab");
  const tab = await chrome.tabs.get(id), origin = new URL(tab.url).origin + "/*";
  if (!(await chrome.permissions.contains({ origins: [origin] })) && !(await chrome.permissions.request({ origins: [origin] }))) throw new Error("Permission denied");
  await chrome.tabs.update(id, { active: true });
  const [r] = await chrome.scripting.executeScript({ target: { tabId: id }, args: [text], func: t => {
    const ok = e => e && (e.isContentEditable || e.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || (e.tagName === "INPUT" && e.type === "text"));
    let el = document.activeElement;
    if (!ok(el)) el = [...document.querySelectorAll('#prompt-textarea,[contenteditable="true"],textarea')].find(e => e.offsetParent !== null);
    if (!el) return "No input box found on that page";
    el.focus();
    if (el.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || el.tagName === "INPUT") {
      const proto = el.tagName === "TEXTAREA" ? HTMLTextAreaElement : HTMLInputElement;
      Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto.prototype, "value").set.call(el, el.value + t);
      el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); return "ok";
    }
    const s = getSelection(); s.selectAllChildren(el); s.collapseToEnd();
    const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.setData("text/plain", t);
    const ev = new ClipboardEvent("paste", { clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
    el.dispatchEvent(ev);
    if (!ev.defaultPrevented) document.execCommand("insertText", false, t);
    return "ok";
  } });
  if (r?.result !== "ok") throw new Error(r?.result || "Insert failed");
}
function btn(txt, fn) { const b = document.createElement("button"); b.textContent = txt; b.onclick = fn; return b; }
function toast(m) { const t = $("toast"); t.textContent = m; t.classList.add("show"); clearTimeout(toast.t); toast.t = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove("show"), 1800); }
function renderChunks(box, items, onUse) {
  box.replaceChildren(...items.map((it, i) => {
    const r = document.createElement("div"); r.className = "chunk";
    const info = document.createElement("div"); info.className = "ci";
    const t = document.createElement("b"), n = document.createElement("small"), p = document.createElement("span");
    t.textContent = it.label; n.textContent = it.text.length.toLocaleString() + " chars"; p.textContent = it.text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 80);
    info.append(t, n, p);
    const use = () => { r.classList.add("done"); onUse && onUse(i); };
    r.append(info,
      btn("Copy", async () => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(it.text); use(); toast("Copied " + it.label); } catch (e) { toast("⚠ " + e.message); } }),
      btn("Insert →", async () => { try { await insertInto(it.text); use(); toast("Inserted " + it.label); } catch (e) { toast("⚠ " + e.message); } }));
    return r;
  }));
}
function splitText(s, size) {
  const out = []; let cur = "";
  for (const p of s.split("\n\n")) {
    if (cur && cur.length + p.length + 2 > size) { out.push(cur); cur = ""; }
    let q = p; while (q.length > size) { if (cur) { out.push(cur); cur = ""; } out.push(q.slice(0, size)); q = q.slice(size); }
    cur = cur ? cur + "\n\n" + q : q;
  }
  if (cur) out.push(cur); return out;
}
let mdParts = [], mdNext = 0;
function refreshNext() { const n = mdParts.length; $("nx").textContent = !n ? "Copy next ▶" : mdNext >= n ? "All copied ✓ (tap to restart)" : `Copy next ▶ ${mdNext + 1}/${n}`; $("ni").textContent = n && mdNext < n ? `Insert ${mdNext + 1}/${n} → tab` : "Insert next → tab"; $("nx").disabled = $("ni").disabled = !n; }
function markUsed(i) { document.querySelectorAll("#l1 .chunk")[i]?.classList.add("done"); mdNext = i + 1; refreshNext(); }
function mdChunks() {
  mdParts = splitText($("out").value, Math.max(1000, +$("mcs").value || 15000)); mdNext = 0; stats();
  renderChunks($("l1"), mdParts.map((t, i) => ({ label: `Part ${i + 1}/${mdParts.length}`, text: t })), i => { mdNext = i + 1; refreshNext(); }); refreshNext();
}
$("nx").onclick = async () => { if (mdNext >= mdParts.length) { mdNext = 0; document.querySelectorAll("#l1 .chunk").forEach(c => c.classList.remove("done")); } const i = mdNext; try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(mdParts[i]); markUsed(i); toast(`Copied part ${i + 1}/${mdParts.length}`); } catch (e) { toast("⚠ " + e.message); } };
$("ni").onclick = async () => { if (mdNext >= mdParts.length) mdNext = 0; const i = mdNext; try { await insertInto(mdParts[i]); markUsed(i); toast(`Inserted part ${i + 1}/${mdParts.length}`); } catch (e) { toast("⚠ " + e.message); } };
$("cancel").onclick = () => { cancelled = true; };
$("out").oninput = stats;
$("mch").onclick = mdChunks;

/* ---------- attach files into other tab ---------- */
async function attachTo(files, mode) {
  const id = +tabSel.value; if (!id) throw new Error("Pick a target tab");
  const tab = await chrome.tabs.get(id), origin = new URL(tab.url).origin + "/*";
  if (!(await chrome.permissions.contains({ origins: [origin] })) && !(await chrome.permissions.request({ origins: [origin] }))) throw new Error("Permission denied");
  const payload = await Promise.all(files.map(async f => ({ name: f.name, type: f.type || "application/octet-stream", bytes: Array.from(new Uint8Array(await f.arrayBuffer())) })));
  await chrome.tabs.update(id, { active: true });
  const [r] = await chrome.scripting.executeScript({ target: { tabId: id }, args: [payload, mode], func: (pl, mode) => {
    const dt = new DataTransfer();
    for (const p of pl) dt.items.add(new File([new Uint8Array(p.bytes)], p.name, { type: p.type }));
    const ok = e => e && (e.isContentEditable || e.tagName === "TEXTAREA");
    let el = document.activeElement;
    if (!ok(el)) el = [...document.querySelectorAll('#prompt-textarea,[contenteditable="true"],textarea')].find(e => e.offsetParent !== null) || document.body;
    el.focus && el.focus();
    if (mode === "auto" || mode === "paste") {
      const pe = new ClipboardEvent("paste", { clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
      el.dispatchEvent(pe);
      if (pe.defaultPrevented) return "ok: paste handled";
      if (mode === "paste") return "paste sent (page did not claim it)";
    }
    if (mode === "auto" || mode === "input") {
      const inp = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[type=file]')].find(i => !i.webkitdirectory);
      if (inp) { inp.files = dt.files; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true })); return "ok: file input"; }
      if (mode === "input") return "no file input found on page";
    }
    for (const t of ["dragenter", "dragover", "drop"]) el.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent(t, { dataTransfer: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
    return "ok: drop sent";
  } });
  return r?.result || "sent";
}

// Shape classifier for glyphs the PDF has no Unicode for (custom-encoded Symbol subsets).
// Input: RGBA pixels of a tight crop around ONE glyph. Output: "−" "=" "+" "(" ")" "[" "]" "×" or null.
export function classifyGlyph(px, W, H) {
  const ink = new Uint8Array(W * H); let x0 = W, x1 = -1, y0 = H, y1 = -1;
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) { const i = (y * W + x) * 4; if ((px[i] + px[i + 1] + px[i + 2]) / 3 < 150 && px[i + 3] > 80) { ink[y * W + x] = 1; if (x < x0) x0 = x; if (x > x1) x1 = x; if (y < y0) y0 = y; if (y > y1) y1 = y; } }
  if (x1 < 0) return null;
  {   // drop connected components that touch the left/right crop edge (they belong to neighbouring glyphs)
    const seen = new Uint8Array(W * H), comps = [];
    for (let sy = 0; sy < H; sy++) for (let sx = 0; sx < W; sx++) {
      if (!ink[sy * W + sx] || seen[sy * W + sx]) continue;
      const st = [[sx, sy]], pts = []; seen[sy * W + sx] = 1; let edge = false, cx0 = W, cx1 = -1;
      while (st.length) { const [x, y] = st.pop(); pts.push(y * W + x); if (x < cx0) cx0 = x; if (x > cx1) cx1 = x; if (x === 0 || x === W - 1) edge = true;
        for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) { const nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy; if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < W && ny < H && ink[ny * W + nx] && !seen[ny * W + nx]) { seen[ny * W + nx] = 1; st.push([nx, ny]); } } }
      comps.push({ pts, edge: edge && cx1 - cx0 + 1 < 0.6 * W });
    }
    if (comps.some(c => !c.edge)) { for (const c of comps) if (c.edge) for (const p of c.pts) ink[p] = 0; x0 = W; x1 = -1; y0 = H; y1 = -1;
      for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) if (ink[y * W + x]) { if (x < x0) x0 = x; if (x > x1) x1 = x; if (y < y0) y0 = y; if (y > y1) y1 = y; } }
    if (x1 < 0) return null;
  }
  const w = x1 - x0 + 1, h = y1 - y0 + 1, rows = [], cols = [];
  for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) { let c = 0; for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) c += ink[y * W + x]; rows.push(c); }
  for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) { let c = 0; for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) c += ink[y * W + x]; cols.push(c); }
  const runs = (a, thr) => { let n = 0, on = false; for (const v of a) { if (v >= thr && !on) { n++; on = true; } else if (v < thr) on = false; } return n; };
  const bands = runs(rows, 0.5 * w);                           // horizontal strokes spanning most of the width
  if (bands >= 2 && h <= 1.1 * w) return "=";
  if (h <= 0.45 * w && bands >= 1) return "−";
  const vstroke = Math.max(...cols) >= 0.7 * h, hstroke = Math.max(...rows) >= 0.7 * w;
  if (bands === 1 && hstroke && vstroke && h <= 1.3 * w && h >= 0.6 * w) return "+";
  if (h >= 2 * w) {                                              // tall thin: bracket or parenthesis
    const cx = y => { let s = 0, n = 0; for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) if (ink[y * W + x]) { s += x; n++; } return n ? s / n : null; };
    const top = cx(y0 + Math.floor(h * 0.1)), mid = cx(y0 + (h >> 1)), bot = cx(y1 - Math.floor(h * 0.1));
    if (top == null || mid == null || bot == null) return null;
    const edge = (top + bot) / 2, straight = Math.abs(mid - edge) < 0.12 * w, corner = rows[0] >= 0.5 * w && rows[rows.length - 1] >= 0.5 * w;
    if (corner) return top < x0 + w / 2 && Math.min(...cols.slice(0, 2)) >= 0.7 * h ? "[" : "]";
    if (straight) return null;
    return mid < edge ? "(" : ")";
  }
  return null;
}

===== FILE: feather_work/layout.js =====
import { structure, tidy, toTex } from "./math.js";
// Recursive XY-cut: finds column gutters (vertical white space) and full-width bands,
// returns blocks in reading order (each column top→bottom, left→right).
// Box: {x0,x1,y,h,s}  — y is baseline in "up" coordinates (bigger = higher on page).
function unionGaps(iv, minGap) {
  iv.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
  const gaps = []; let end = iv[0][1];
  for (let i = 1; i < iv.length; i++) {
    if (iv[i][0] - end >= minGap) gaps.push([end, iv[i][0]]);
    if (iv[i][1] > end) end = iv[i][1];
  }
  return gaps;
}
function extentY(g) { let lo = Infinity, hi = -Infinity; for (const b of g) { if (b.y < lo) lo = b.y; if (b.y + b.h > hi) hi = b.y + b.h; } return hi - lo; }
function vcut(bs, G, medH) {
  if (bs.length < 12) return null;
  const gaps = unionGaps(bs.map(b => [b.x0, b.x1]), G);
  if (!gaps.length) return null;
  const mids = gaps.map(g => (g[0] + g[1]) / 2);
  const groups = Array.from({ length: mids.length + 1 }, () => []);
  for (const b of bs) { const c = (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2; let k = 0; while (k < mids.length && c > mids[k]) k++; groups[k].push(b); }
  const strong = g => g.length >= 5 && extentY(g) >= 3 * medH;   // a real column has several lines
  const out = []; let carry = [];
  for (const g of groups) { const m = carry.concat(g); if (strong(m)) { out.push(m); carry = []; } else carry = m; }
  if (carry.length) { if (!out.length) return null; out[out.length - 1].push(...carry); }
  return out.length > 1 ? out : null;
}
// Gutters tolerant of a few full-width elements (titles, captions, page numbers):
// x-ranges where the summed box height covering x is ≤25% of the peak.
function tolerantGutters(bs, G) {
  const ev = [];
  for (const b of bs) { ev.push([b.x0, b.h]); ev.push([b.x1, -b.h]); }
  ev.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
  let cov = 0, M = 0; const segs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < ev.length - 1; i++) { cov += ev[i][1]; if (cov > M) M = cov; if (ev[i + 1][0] > ev[i][0]) segs.push([ev[i][0], ev[i + 1][0], cov]); }
  const thr = 0.25 * M, out = []; let cur = null;
  for (const [x0, x1, c] of segs) {
    if (c <= thr) { if (cur) cur[1] = x1; else out.push(cur = [x0, x1]); } else cur = null;
  }
  return out.filter(g => g[1] - g[0] >= G);
}
// Split into ordered pieces: bands of "spanner" boxes (cross a gutter) and the column regions between them.
function bandSplit(bs, G, medH) {
  const gut = tolerantGutters(bs, G);
  if (!gut.length) return null;
  const span = [], rest = [];
  for (const b of bs) (gut.some(g => b.x1 > g[0] && b.x0 < g[1]) ? span : rest).push(b);
  if (!span.length || span.length > 0.15 * bs.length || rest.length < 12 || !vcut(rest, G, medH)) return null;
  const pad = 0.3 * medH, iv = span.map(b => [b.y - pad, b.y + b.h + pad]).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  const bands = [];                       // merged y-intervals, top → bottom
  for (const v of iv) { const l = bands[bands.length - 1]; if (l && v[1] >= l[1]) l[1] = Math.min(l[1], v[0]); else bands.push([v[1], v[0]]); }
  const pieces = []; const inBand = bands.map(() => []); const regions = Array.from({ length: bands.length + 1 }, () => []);
  for (const b of bs) {
    const c = b.y + b.h / 2; let k = bands.findIndex(v => c <= v[0] && c >= v[1]);
    if (k >= 0) inBand[k].push(b);
    else { let r = 0; while (r < bands.length && c < bands[r][1]) r++; regions[r].push(b); }
  }
  for (let r = 0; r <= bands.length; r++) {
    if (regions[r].length) pieces.push({ boxes: regions[r], leaf: false });
    if (r < bands.length && inBand[r].length) pieces.push({ boxes: inBand[r], leaf: true });
  }
  return pieces;
}
export function xyBlocks(bs, G, medH, depth = 0) {
  if (bs.length < 2 || depth > 10) return [bs];
  const v = vcut(bs, G, medH);
  if (v) return v.flatMap(g => xyBlocks(g, G, medH, depth + 1));
  if (bs.length >= 12) {
    const p = bandSplit(bs, G, medH);
    if (p) return p.flatMap(x => x.leaf ? [x.boxes] : xyBlocks(x.boxes, G, medH, depth + 1));
  }
  return [bs];
}

const esc = s => s.replace(/\|/g, "\\|");
export function linesFromItems(items) {
  const rows = [];
  for (const it of items) {
    if (!it.str.trim()) continue;
    const y = it.transform[5], h = Math.abs(it.transform[3]) || it.height || 10;
    let r = rows.find(r => Math.abs(r.y - y) < h * 0.4);
    if (!r) rows.push(r = { y, h, items: [] });
    r.items.push({ x: it.transform[4], w: it.width, s: it.str });
  }
  rows.sort((a, b) => b.y - a.y);
  for (const r of rows) {
    r.items.sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
    r.cells = []; let cur = null, end = 0;
    for (const i of r.items) {
      if (cur && i.x - end < r.h * 1.2) cur.s += (i.x - end > r.h * 0.15 ? " " : "") + i.s;
      else r.cells.push(cur = { x: i.x, s: i.s });
      end = i.x + i.w;
    }
    r.text = r.cells.map(c => c.s).join(" ").trim();
  }
  return rows;
}
export function rowsToMd(rows, tables, headings = true, medIn) {
  const hs = rows.map(r => r.h).sort((a, b) => a - b), med = medIn || hs[hs.length >> 1] || 10;
  const out = []; let i = 0;
  while (i < rows.length) {
    const r = rows[i];
    if (tables && r.cells.length >= 2) {
      let j = i; while (j < rows.length && rows[j].cells.length >= 2) j++;
      const ENUM = /^(\(?([ivxlc]+|[a-z]|\d+)[).]|[∗•*▪●◦–-])$/i, grp = rows.slice(i, j);
      const enumRows = grp.filter(r => ENUM.test(r.cells[0].s.trim()) || r.cells.every(c => ENUM.test(c.s.trim().split(/\s+/)[0]))).length;
      if (j - i >= 2 && enumRows / (j - i) < 0.6) {
        const cols = [...new Set(rows.slice(i, j).flatMap(r => r.cells.map(c => Math.round(c.x / 8))))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
        const merged = []; cols.forEach(c => { if (!merged.length || c - merged[merged.length - 1] > 2) merged.push(c); });
        const grid = rows.slice(i, j).map(r => { const row = Array(merged.length).fill("");
          r.cells.forEach(c => { const cx = Math.round(c.x / 8); let k = 0; merged.forEach((m, n) => { if (cx >= m - 2) k = n; }); row[k] = (row[k] + " " + c.s).trim(); }); return row; });
        out.push("", "| " + grid[0].map(esc).join(" | ") + " |", "|" + merged.map(() => " --- |").join(""));
        grid.slice(1).forEach(g => out.push("| " + g.map(esc).join(" | ") + " |")); out.push("");
        i = j; continue;
      }
    }
    const prev = out.length && rows[i - 1];
    if (prev && prev.y - r.y > r.h * 2) out.push("");
    let t = r.text;
    if (headings && r.h > med * 1.5) t = "# " + t; else if (headings && r.h > med * 1.2) t = "## " + t;
    else if (/^[•▪●◦-]\s/.test(t)) t = "- " + t.slice(2);
    out.push(t); i++;
  }
  return out.join("\n");
}

export function boxesToMd(boxes, o) {
  if (!boxes.length) return "";
  const hs0 = boxes.filter(b => b.s.length !== 1 || b.s < "\uf8e0").map(b => b.h).sort((a, b) => a - b), med = hs0[hs0.length >> 1] || 10;
  boxes = structure(boxes, o.shapes, { style: o.math, med, mathify });          // fractions, radicals, big brackets
  boxes = mathify(boxes, o.math);                                                 // super/subscripts
  if (o.math === "latex") boxes = boxes.map(b => b.m ? { ...b, s: "$" + b.s + "$" } : b);
  const blocks = o.cols ? xyBlocks(boxes, 1.2 * med, med) : [boxes];
  const md = blocks.map(bl => rowsToMd(linesFromItems(bl.map(b => ({ str: b.s, transform: [0, 0, 0, b.h, b.x0, b.y], width: b.x1 - b.x0, height: b.h }))), o.tables, o.headings, med)).filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
  return o.math === "latex" ? md.split("\n").map(tidy).join("\n") : md;
}

/* ---------- superscript / subscript → math ---------- */
const SUP = { "0":"⁰","1":"¹","2":"²","3":"³","4":"⁴","5":"⁵","6":"⁶","7":"⁷","8":"⁸","9":"⁹","+":"⁺","-":"⁻","=":"⁼","(":"⁽",")":"⁾","n":"ⁿ","i":"ⁱ" };
const SUB = { "0":"₀","1":"₁","2":"₂","3":"₃","4":"₄","5":"₅","6":"₆","7":"₇","8":"₈","9":"₉","+":"₊","-":"₋","=":"₌","(":"₍",")":"₎","a":"ₐ","e":"ₑ","o":"ₒ","x":"ₓ","n":"ₙ","i":"ᵢ","j":"ⱼ" };
function fmtScript(kind, txt, style) {
  const t = txt.replace(/\s+/g, "").replace(/[−–]/g, "-"), up = kind === "sup", sym = up ? "^" : "_";
  if (style === "latex") return `${sym}{${t}}`;
  if (style === "unicode") { const m = up ? SUP : SUB; if ([...t].every(c => m[c])) return [...t].map(c => m[c]).join(""); }
  return t.length === 1 ? sym + t : `${sym}(${t})`;
}
export function mathify(boxes, style, wrap = true) {
  if (!style || style === "off" || boxes.length < 2) return boxes;
  const order = boxes.map((b, i) => i).sort((a, b) => boxes[a].x0 - boxes[b].x0);
  const groups = new Map(), assigned = [], isScript = new Set();
  for (const i of order) {
    const s = boxes[i]; if (!s.s.trim()) continue;
    let done = false;
    for (const p of assigned) {           // continuation of a multi-glyph script (e.g. "−" then "3")
      if (Math.abs(s.h - p.h) < 0.1 * p.h && Math.abs(s.y - p.y) < 0.12 * p.h && s.x0 - p.x1 > -0.2 * p.h && s.x0 - p.x1 < 0.4 * p.h) {
        p.text += s.s; p.x1 = s.x1; isScript.add(s); done = true; break;
      }
    }
    if (done) continue;
    let best = null, bg = 1e9;
    for (const b of boxes) {
      if (b === s || isScript.has(b) || s.h > 0.85 * b.h || /\s$/.test(b.s)) continue;
      const gap = s.x0 - b.x1; if (gap < -0.3 * b.h || gap > 0.6 * b.h) continue;
      const dy = s.y - b.y, up = dy >= 0.2 * b.h && dy <= 0.9 * b.h, dn = dy <= -0.08 * b.h && dy >= -0.5 * b.h;
      if ((up || dn) && Math.abs(gap) < bg) { bg = Math.abs(gap); best = { b, kind: up ? "sup" : "sub" }; }
    }
    if (!best) continue;
    const g = { kind: best.kind, text: s.s, x0: s.x0, x1: s.x1, y: s.y, h: s.h };
    assigned.push(g); isScript.add(s);
    if (!groups.has(best.b)) groups.set(best.b, []);
    groups.get(best.b).push(g);
  }
  if (!groups.size) return boxes;
  const rest = boxes.filter(b => !isScript.has(b)).sort((a, b) => a.x0 - b.x0).map(b => ({ ...b, _o: b }));
  const info = new Map();   // box -> {pre, tok, x1, x0, has, changed}
  for (const b of rest) {
    const m = /([A-Za-zπθαβγδΔφωλμσρτ0-9)\]]+|\$?\\[A-Za-z{}0-9]+)$/.exec(b.s), gs = (groups.get(b._o) || []).sort((a, c) => a.x0 - c.x0);
    const tok = (m ? m[1] : "") + gs.map(g => fmtScript(g.kind, g.text, style)).join("");
    info.set(b, { pre: m ? b.s.slice(0, m.index) : b.s, tok, x1: Math.max(b.x1, ...gs.map(g => g.x1)), x0: b.x0, has: gs.length > 0, changed: gs.length > 0 });
  }
  const gone = new Set();
  for (const b of rest) {                 // glue following glyph runs: H₂ + O, S + O₄ …
    if (gone.has(b)) continue; const I = info.get(b);
    while (I.has && style !== "latex") {
      const c = rest.find(c => c !== b && !gone.has(c) && Math.abs(c.y - b.y) < 0.2 * b.h && Math.abs(c.h - b.h) < 0.15 * b.h
        && c.x0 - I.x1 > -0.2 * b.h && c.x0 - I.x1 < 0.12 * b.h && c.s.trim() === c.s);
      if (!c) break;
      const J = info.get(c); I.changed = true;
      if (/\s/.test(c.s)) {              // only the leading word belongs to the formula
        const head = /^\S+/.exec(c.s)[0]; I.tok += head; I.x1 = c.x0 + (c.x1 - c.x0) * head.length / c.s.length;
        J.pre = J.pre.slice(head.length); J.x0 = I.x1; J.mod = true; I.has = false;
      } else { I.tok += J.tok; I.x1 = J.x1; I.has = J.has; gone.add(c); }
    }
  }
  return rest.filter(b => !gone.has(b)).map(b => {
    const I = info.get(b);
    if (!I.changed && !I.mod) return b._o;
    return { ...b._o, x0: I.x0, x1: I.x1, s: I.pre + (I.changed && style === "latex" ? (wrap ? `$${toTex(I.tok)}$` : I.tok) : I.tok), m: false };
  });
}

===== FILE: feather_work/math.js =====
// Math reconstruction helpers for Feather.
// 1) Symbol-font glyph repair (q→θ, p→π, a→α, D→Δ …)  2) vector shapes from the PDF operator list
//    (fraction bars, radical signs)  3) collapse stacked boxes into  a/b  and  √x  4) big-bracket pieces.
// Boxes: {x0,x1,y,h,s}  y = baseline ("up" coordinates).  m:true → s is a math fragment (no $ yet).

/* ---------- glyph repair ---------- */
const SYM = { a:"α",b:"β",c:"χ",d:"δ",e:"ε",f:"φ",g:"γ",h:"η",i:"ι",j:"ϕ",k:"κ",l:"λ",m:"μ",n:"ν",o:"ο",p:"π",q:"θ",r:"ρ",s:"σ",t:"τ",u:"υ",v:"ϖ",w:"ω",x:"ξ",y:"ψ",z:"ζ",
  D:"Δ",F:"Φ",G:"Γ",J:"ϑ",L:"Λ",P:"Π",Q:"Θ",S:"Σ",W:"Ω",X:"Ξ",Y:"Ψ" };
export const BRK = { "\uf8eb":"(","\uf8ec":"(","\uf8ed":"(","\uf8f6":")","\uf8f7":")","\uf8f8":")","\uf8ee":"[","\uf8ef":"[","\uf8f0":"[","\uf8f9":"]","\uf8fa":"]","\uf8fb":"]",
  "\uf8f1":"{","\uf8f2":"{","\uf8f3":"{","\uf8fc":"}","\uf8fd":"}","\uf8fe":"}" };
export const UNKNOWN = "⟨?⟩";
// fontName = real PDF font name (e.g. "ABCDEF+SymbolMT"); returns repaired string
export function fixText(s, fontName) {
  const f = fontName || "";
  if (/symbol/i.test(f)) s = s.replace(/[A-Za-z]/g, c => SYM[c] || c);
  else if (/wingdings|zapf|dingbats/i.test(f)) s = s.replace(/[\uf000-\uf0ff]/g, "•");
  // control chars = glyphs the font has no Unicode for (shown as a visible placeholder instead of vanishing)
  s = s.replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f]/g, UNKNOWN);
  return s;
}

/* ---------- vector shapes from operator list ---------- */
const mul = (a, b) => [a[0]*b[0]+a[2]*b[1], a[1]*b[0]+a[3]*b[1], a[0]*b[2]+a[2]*b[3], a[1]*b[2]+a[3]*b[3], a[0]*b[4]+a[2]*b[5]+a[4], a[1]*b[4]+a[3]*b[5]+a[5]];
// returns {bars:[{x0,x1,y}], rads:[{x0,x1,bx0,bx1,yb,yt}]}
export function shapesFromOps(ol, OPS, pageW = 600, pageH = 800) {
  const bars = [], rads = [], vbars = [], glyphs = [], heads = [], prims = [], st = []; let ctm = [1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0];
  const PAINT = new Set([OPS.stroke, OPS.closeStroke, OPS.fill, OPS.eoFill, OPS.fillStroke, OPS.eoFillStroke, OPS.closeFillStroke, OPS.closeEOFillStroke, OPS.endPath, OPS.clip, OPS.eoClip]);
  const FILL = new Set([OPS.fill, OPS.eoFill, OPS.fillStroke, OPS.eoFillStroke, OPS.closeFillStroke, OPS.closeEOFillStroke]);
  const STROKE = new Set([OPS.stroke, OPS.closeStroke, OPS.fillStroke, OPS.eoFillStroke, OPS.closeFillStroke, OPS.closeEOFillStroke]);
  const { fnArray: fn, argsArray: ar } = ol;
  for (let i = 0; i < fn.length; i++) {
    const f = fn[i], a = ar[i];
    if (f === OPS.save) st.push(ctm);
    else if (f === OPS.restore) ctm = st.pop() || ctm;
    else if (f === OPS.transform) ctm = mul(ctm, a);
    else if (f === OPS.paintFormXObjectBegin) { st.push(ctm); if (a && a[0]) ctm = mul(ctm, a[0]); }
    else if (f === OPS.paintFormXObjectEnd) ctm = st.pop() || ctm;
    else if (f === OPS.paintImageXObject || f === OPS.paintInlineImageXObject || f === OPS.paintImageMaskXObject) {
      const q = [[0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 1]].map(([x, y]) => [ctm[0]*x + ctm[2]*y + ctm[4], ctm[1]*x + ctm[3]*y + ctm[5]]), xs = q.map(p => p[0]), ys = q.map(p => p[1]);
      prims.push({ x0: Math.min(...xs), x1: Math.max(...xs), y0: Math.min(...ys), y1: Math.max(...ys), k: "img" });
    }
    else if (f === OPS.constructPath) {
      let paint = -1; for (let k = i + 1; k < Math.min(fn.length, i + 4); k++) if (PAINT.has(fn[k])) { paint = fn[k]; break; }
      if (paint < 0 || paint === OPS.endPath || paint === OPS.clip || paint === OPS.eoClip) continue;
      const [ops, co] = a, pts = [], subs = []; let c = 0, onlyLines = true;
      for (const op of ops) {
        if (op === OPS.moveTo || op === OPS.lineTo) { if (op === OPS.moveTo) subs.push([]); subs[subs.length - 1]?.push([co[c], co[c + 1]]); pts.push([co[c], co[c + 1]]); c += 2; }
        else if (op === OPS.rectangle) { const x = co[c], y = co[c + 1], w = co[c + 2], h = co[c + 3]; pts.push([x, y], [x + w, y], [x + w, y + h], [x, y + h]); c += 4; onlyLines = false; }
        else if (op === OPS.curveTo) { c += 6; onlyLines = false; } else if (op === OPS.curveTo2 || op === OPS.curveTo3) { c += 4; onlyLines = false; }
      }
      if (!pts.length) continue;
      if (STROKE.has(paint) && subs.length > 1 && subs.every(sp => sp.length === 2)) {      // several rules in one stroked path
        for (const sp of subs) { const q = sp.map(([x, y]) => [ctm[0]*x + ctm[2]*y + ctm[4], ctm[1]*x + ctm[3]*y + ctm[5]]), w = Math.abs(q[1][0] - q[0][0]);
          if (w > 3 && w < pageW * 0.6 && Math.abs(q[1][1] - q[0][1]) < 0.4) bars.push({ x0: Math.min(q[0][0], q[1][0]), x1: Math.max(q[0][0], q[1][0]), y: (q[0][1] + q[1][1]) / 2 }); }
        continue;
      }
      const P = pts.map(([x, y]) => [ctm[0]*x + ctm[2]*y + ctm[4], ctm[1]*x + ctm[3]*y + ctm[5]]);
      const xs = P.map(p => p[0]), ys = P.map(p => p[1]), x0 = Math.min(...xs), x1 = Math.max(...xs), y0 = Math.min(...ys), y1 = Math.max(...ys), w = x1 - x0, h = y1 - y0;
      // horizontal rule: stroked 2-point line, or thin filled rectangle
      if (w > 3 && w < pageW * 0.6 && ((STROKE.has(paint) && P.length <= 2 && h < 0.4) || (FILL.has(paint) && h < 1.5 && h >= 0))) { bars.push({ x0, x1, y: (y0 + y1) / 2 }); prims.push({ x0, x1, y0, y1, k: "h" }); continue; }
      // vertical rule (determinant / abs bars)
      if (w < 0.5 && h > 14 && h < 200 && ((STROKE.has(paint) && P.length <= 2) || FILL.has(paint) && P.length <= 4)) { vbars.push({ x: (x0 + x1) / 2, y0, y1 }); prims.push({ x0, x1, y0, y1, k: "v" }); continue; }
      if (FILL.has(paint) && w < 1.5 && h > 14 && h < 200 && !onlyLines === false) { vbars.push({ x: (x0 + x1) / 2, y0, y1 }); prims.push({ x0, x1, y0, y1, k: "v" }); continue; }
      // radical sign: filled polygon (lines only) whose top edge is the overbar and which has a left tick below it
      if (FILL.has(paint) && onlyLines && P.length >= 6 && w > 4 && w < 250 && h > 5 && h < 45) {
        const top = P.filter(p => y1 - p[1] < 0.35); if (top.length < 2) continue;
        const bx0 = Math.min(...top.map(p => p[0])), bx1 = Math.max(...top.map(p => p[0]));
        if (bx1 - bx0 < 2 || x0 > bx0 - 1) continue;
        rads.push({ x0, x1, bx0, bx1, yb: y0, yt: y1 }); continue;
      }
      if (FILL.has(paint) && onlyLines && P.length >= 3 && P.length <= 5 && w < 9 && h < 9) { heads.push({ x0, x1, y: (y0 + y1) / 2 }); continue; }
      if (FILL.has(paint) && !onlyLines && w < 22 && h < 22) { glyphs.push({ x0, x1, y0, y1 }); continue; }   // outlined (vector) glyph
      if (w > 2 || h > 2) prims.push({ x0, x1, y0, y1, k: STROKE.has(paint) ? (!onlyLines || P.length > 2 ? "c" : (w >= h ? "h" : "v")) : "f", pts: P.length });
    }
  }
  const figs = clusterFigs(prims, pageW, pageH);
  const inFig = (x, y) => figs.some(g => x >= g.x0 && x <= g.x1 && y >= g.y0 && y <= g.y1);
  const dup = b => rads.some(r => Math.abs(b.y - r.yt) < 1.5 && b.x0 < r.bx1 + 1 && b.x1 > r.bx0 - 1);
  return { bars: bars.filter(b => !dup(b) && !inFig((b.x0 + b.x1) / 2, b.y)), rads: rads.filter(r => !inFig((r.bx0 + r.bx1) / 2, r.yb)), vbars: vbars.filter(v => !inFig(v.x, (v.y0 + v.y1) / 2)), glyphs: glyphs.filter(g => !inFig((g.x0 + g.x1) / 2, (g.y0 + g.y1) / 2)), figs, heads };
}

/* ---------- graph / figure detection ---------- */
// Groups drawing primitives (images, curves, many strokes) into regions. A region with a long horizontal AND a long
// vertical line (axes) is a graph. Ordinary rules/underlines/table borders alone never qualify.
function clusterFigs(prims, pageW, pageH) {
  const M = 5, P = prims.filter(p => !(p.k === "h" && p.x1 - p.x0 > pageW * 0.6) && !(p.x1 - p.x0 > pageW * 0.9 && p.y1 - p.y0 > pageH * 0.6) && (p.k !== "f" || (p.x1 - p.x0 > 3 && p.y1 - p.y0 > 3) || p.pts > 4));
  const par = P.map((_, i) => i), find = i => par[i] === i ? i : (par[i] = find(par[i]));
  const ov = (a, b) => a.x0 - M < b.x1 && b.x0 - M < a.x1 && a.y0 - M < b.y1 && b.y0 - M < a.y1;
  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < P.length; j++) if (ov(P[i], P[j])) par[find(i)] = find(j);
  const cl = new Map(); P.forEach((p, i) => { const r = find(i); (cl.get(r) || cl.set(r, []).get(r)).push(p); });
  const out = [];
  for (const g of cl.values()) {
    const x0 = Math.min(...g.map(p => p.x0)), x1 = Math.max(...g.map(p => p.x1)), y0 = Math.min(...g.map(p => p.y0)), y1 = Math.max(...g.map(p => p.y1)), w = x1 - x0, h = y1 - y0;
    if (w < 45 || h < 45 || (w > pageW * 0.95 && h > pageH * 0.85)) continue;
    const img = g.some(p => p.k === "img" && p.x1 - p.x0 > 45 && p.y1 - p.y0 > 45), curves = g.filter(p => p.k === "c" || p.k === "f").length;
    const hl = g.some(p => (p.k === "h") && p.x1 - p.x0 > 0.5 * w), vl = g.some(p => p.k === "v" && p.y1 - p.y0 > 0.5 * h);
    const lines = g.filter(p => p.k === "h" || p.k === "v").length;
    const longH = g.filter(p => p.k === "h" && p.x1 - p.x0 > 0.6 * w).length;
    if (longH >= 3 && curves < 3 && !img) continue;                      // grid of rules = table, not a figure
    if (!(img || curves >= 3 || (hl && vl))) continue;
    out.push({ x0, x1, y0, y1, kind: hl && vl ? "graph" : img ? "image" : "figure", n: g.length });
  }
  return out;
}

/* ---------- LaTeX helpers ---------- */
const TEXG = { "π":"\\pi ","θ":"\\theta ","α":"\\alpha ","β":"\\beta ","γ":"\\gamma ","δ":"\\delta ","Δ":"\\Delta ","φ":"\\phi ","ϕ":"\\phi ","ω":"\\omega ","Ω":"\\Omega ","λ":"\\lambda ","μ":"\\mu ","σ":"\\sigma ","ρ":"\\rho ","τ":"\\tau ","ε":"\\epsilon ","η":"\\eta ","Σ":"\\Sigma ","Π":"\\Pi ","Γ":"\\Gamma ","Θ":"\\Theta ",
  "≤":"\\le ","≥":"\\ge ","≠":"\\ne ","∈":"\\in ","±":"\\pm ","×":"\\times ","÷":"\\div ","−":"-","–":"-","∗":"*","º":"^{\\circ}","°":"^{\\circ}","∠":"\\angle ","∞":"\\infty ","∴":"\\therefore ","→":"\\to ","∫":"\\int ","∬":"\\iint ","∭":"\\iiint ","∮":"\\oint ","∑":"\\sum ","∏":"\\prod ","∂":"\\partial ","∇":"\\nabla ","·":"\\cdot ","⋅":"\\cdot ","≈":"\\approx ","≡":"\\equiv ","∝":"\\propto ","⊥":"\\perp ","∥":"\\parallel ","′":"'","″":"''","∪":"\\cup ","∩":"\\cap ","⊂":"\\subset ","∅":"\\emptyset ","∀":"\\forall ","∃":"\\exists ","⇒":"\\Rightarrow ","⇔":"\\Leftrightarrow ","∉":"\\notin " };
export function toTex(s) {
  s = s.replace(/[πθαβγδΔφϕωΩλμσρτεηΣΠΓΘ≤≥≠∈±×÷−–∗º°∠∞∴→∫∬∭∮∑∏∂∇·⋅≈≡∝⊥∥′″∪∩⊂∅∀∃⇒⇔∉]/g, c => TEXG[c] || c);
  s = s.replace(/(?<![\\A-Za-z])(sin|cos|tan|cot|sec|log|ln)(?![A-Za-z])/g, "\\$1 ").replace(/(?<![\\A-Za-z])cosec(?![A-Za-z])/g, "\\operatorname{cosec} ");
  return s;
}
const simple = t => /^[A-Za-z0-9.πθαβγδΔφω⟨?⟩⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹ⁿ₀-₉^_]+$/.test(t) || /^\(.*\)$/.test(t) && !/\)\s*[^)]*\(/.test(t);
const plainFrac = (n, d) => `${simple(n) ? n : "(" + n + ")"}/${simple(d) ? d : "(" + d + ")"}`;

/* ---------- structure collapse ---------- */
function splitAt(b, x) {                       // split a text box at the whitespace nearest to x (returns null if none)
  const s = b.s, n = s.length; if (n < 3 || !(x > b.x0 + 1 && x < b.x1 - 1)) return null;
  let best = -1, bd = 1e9;
  for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) if (/\s/.test(s[i])) { const px = b.x0 + (b.x1 - b.x0) * (i + 0.5) / n, d = Math.abs(px - x); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = i; } }
  if (best < 0 || bd > (b.x1 - b.x0) * 0.3) return null;
  const px = b.x0 + (b.x1 - b.x0) * (best + 0.5) / n, L = s.slice(0, best).trimEnd(), R = s.slice(best + 1).trimStart();
  if (!L || !R) return null;
  return [{ ...b, s: L, x1: px - 0.5 }, { ...b, s: R, x0: px + 0.5 }];
}
export function structure(boxes, shapes, o) {
  const style = o.style, med = o.med || 12, mathify = o.mathify, tex = style === "latex";
  let items = boxes.map(b => ({ ...b }));
  if (tex) items = items.map(b => /[∫∬∭∮∑∏∂∇]/.test(b.s) && !b.m ? { ...b, s: toTex(b.s).trim(), m: true } : b);
  const join = bs => {
    bs = mathify(bs, tex ? "latex" : style, false).sort((a, b) => a.x0 - b.x0);
    let out = "", end = null;
    for (const b of bs) { const t = b.m || !tex ? b.s : toTex(b.s); out += (end !== null && b.x0 - end > 0.2 * med ? " " : "") + t; end = b.x1; }
    return out.trim();
  };
  // 1) bracket pieces → one box per stack
  const pcs = items.filter(b => b.s.length === 1 && BRK[b.s]); items = items.filter(b => !(b.s.length === 1 && BRK[b.s]));
  const brs = []; pcs.sort((a, b) => a.x0 - b.x0 || b.y - a.y);
  for (const p of pcs) { const ch = BRK[p.s], c = brs.find(c => c.ch === ch && Math.abs(c.x0 - p.x0) < 1.5 && (p.y > c.ymax ? p.y - c.ymax : c.ymin - p.y) < 1.25 * med);
    if (c) { c.ymax = Math.max(c.ymax, p.y); c.ymin = Math.min(c.ymin, p.y); } else brs.push({ ch, x0: p.x0, x1: p.x1, ymax: p.y, ymin: p.y }); }

  // ---- accents above a letter: vector arrow, bar, hat, tilde, dot
  const ACC = { "→": "vec", "\u20d7": "vec", "\u20d1": "vec", "¯": "bar", "‾": "bar", "ˉ": "bar", "ˆ": "hat", "^": "hat", "˜": "tilde", "˙": "dot", "¨": "ddot" }, COMB = { vec: "\u20d7", bar: "\u0304", hat: "\u0302", tilde: "\u0303", dot: "\u0307", ddot: "\u0308" };
  for (const a of items.filter(b => !b.m && b.s.length === 1 && ACC[b.s] && b.x1 - b.x0 <= 1.4 * med)) {
    const L = items.find(b => b !== a && !b.m && !b.br && /^[A-Za-zα-ωΑ-Ω]{1,3}$/.test(b.s) && (a.x0 + a.x1) / 2 >= b.x0 - 2 && (a.x0 + a.x1) / 2 <= b.x1 + 2 && a.y - b.y > 0.45 * med && a.y - b.y < 1.7 * med);
    if (!L) continue; const k = ACC[a.s];
    items = items.filter(b => b !== a && b !== L);
    items.push({ ...L, s: tex ? `\\${k}{${L.s}}` : style === "unicode" ? [...L.s].map(c => c + COMB[k]).join("") : `${k}(${L.s})`, m: tex });
  }

  // ---- big operators (∫ ∑ ∏): attach upper/lower limits, and normalise the tall glyph to line height
  const BIGSYM = /^(?:[∫∬∭∮∑∏]|\\(?:int|iint|iiint|oint|sum|prod))$/;
  for (const O of items.filter(b => BIGSYM.test(b.s.trim()) && !b.done)) {
    const near = items.filter(b => b !== O && !b.br && b.h <= 0.9 * med && b.x0 >= O.x0 - 2 && b.x0 <= O.x1 + 0.6 * med);
    const grab = (seed) => { const g = [...seed]; let grew = true; while (grew && g.length) { grew = false; for (const b of items) if (!g.includes(b) && !b.br && b.h <= 0.9 * med && Math.abs(b.y - g[0].y) < 0.4 * med && b.x0 - Math.max(...g.map(q => q.x1)) < 0.5 * med && b.x0 >= g[0].x0 - 1 && b.x0 > Math.min(...g.map(q => q.x0))) { g.push(b); grew = true; } } return g; };
    const hi = grab(near.filter(b => b.y >= O.y + 0.55 * O.h)), lo = grab(near.filter(b => b.y + 0.7 * b.h <= O.y + 0.35 * O.h));
    const used = new Set([...hi, ...lo]); items = items.filter(b => !used.has(b));
    const sym = O.s.trim(), J = g => g.length ? join(g) : "", H = J(hi), L = J(lo), sm = t => simple(t) ? t : `(${t})`;
    O.s = tex ? `${sym.startsWith("\\") ? sym : toTex(sym).trim()}${L ? `_{${L}}` : ""}${H ? `^{${H}}` : ""}` : `${sym}${L ? `_${sm(L)}` : ""}${H ? `^${sm(H)}` : ""}`;
    O.m = tex; O.done = true; O.y = O.y + 0.25 * O.h; O.h = med; O.x1 = Math.max(O.x1, ...hi.map(b => b.x1), ...lo.map(b => b.x1));
  }
  if (shapes && (shapes.bars.length || shapes.rads.length)) {
    const structs = [...shapes.bars.map(b => ({ t: "f", ...b })), ...shapes.rads.map(r => ({ t: "r", ...r, x0: r.bx0, x1: r.bx1, px0: r.x0 }))];
    // 2) split text runs that straddle a bar edge (e.g. "A b" = end of one numerator + start of the next)
    for (const s of structs) for (const e of [s.x0, s.x1]) {
      const out = [];
      for (const b of items) { const near = s.t === "f" ? (b.y > s.y - 1.7 * med && b.y < s.y + 1.3 * med) : (b.y > s.yb - 3 && b.y < s.yt + 3); const sp = near && b.x0 < e - 1 && b.x1 > e + 1 ? splitAt(b, e) : null; if (sp) out.push(...sp); else out.push(b); }
      items = out;
    }
    structs.sort((a, b) => (a.x1 - a.x0) - (b.x1 - b.x0));      // innermost (narrowest) first
    const cx = b => (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2, inX = (b, s) => cx(b) >= s.x0 - 1.5 && cx(b) <= s.x1 + 1.5;
    for (const s of structs) {
      if (s.t === "f") {
        const num = items.filter(b => inX(b, s) && b.y >= s.y + 1.5 && b.y <= s.y + 1.25 * med);
        const den = items.filter(b => inX(b, s) && b.y + 0.7 * b.h <= s.y + 1 && b.y + 0.7 * b.h >= s.y - 1.7 * med);
        if (!num.length && den.length) {                      // bar with text only underneath: overline / vector
          const mem = den.filter(b => b.y + 0.7 * b.h >= s.y - 0.5 * med), wM = mem.length ? Math.max(...mem.map(b => b.x1)) - Math.min(...mem.map(b => b.x0)) : 0;
          if (mem.length && s.x1 - s.x0 <= 1.4 * wM + 4) {
            const R = join(mem), arrow = (shapes.heads || []).some(h => Math.abs(h.y - s.y) < 3 && h.x0 > s.x1 - 4 && h.x0 < s.x1 + 5), set = new Set(mem);
            items = items.filter(b => !set.has(b));
            items.push({ x0: s.x0, x1: s.x1, y: Math.min(...mem.map(b => b.y)), h: med, m: tex, s: tex ? (arrow ? `\\vec{${R}}` : `\\overline{${R}}`) : style === "unicode" ? [...R].map(c => c + (arrow ? "⃗" : "̅")).join("") : `${arrow ? "vec" : "bar"}(${R})` });
          }
          continue;
        }
        if (!num.length || !den.length) continue;
        const ext = bs => Math.max(...bs.map(b => b.x1)) - Math.min(...bs.map(b => b.x0)), wN = ext(num), wD = ext(den), bw = s.x1 - s.x0;
        const cN = (Math.min(...num.map(b => b.x0)) + Math.max(...num.map(b => b.x1))) / 2, cD = (Math.min(...den.map(b => b.x0)) + Math.max(...den.map(b => b.x1))) / 2, cB = (s.x0 + s.x1) / 2;
        if (bw > 1.3 * Math.max(wN, wD) + 6 || Math.abs(cN - cB) > 0.3 * bw + 3 || Math.abs(cD - cB) > 0.3 * bw + 3) continue;     // not a real fraction bar (table rule, underline …)
        const N = join(num), D = join(den), set = new Set([...num, ...den]);
        items = items.filter(b => !set.has(b));
        items.push({ x0: s.x0, x1: s.x1, y: s.y - 0.22 * med, h: med, s: tex ? `\\frac{${N}}{${D}}` : plainFrac(N, D), m: true });
      } else {
        const mem = items.filter(b => inX(b, { x0: s.x0 - 0.5, x1: s.x1 + 0.5 }) && b.y + 0.35 * b.h > s.yb - 0.5 && b.y + 0.35 * b.h < s.yt + 0.5);
        if (!mem.length) continue;
        const R = join(mem), set = new Set(mem), base = Math.min(...mem.map(b => b.y));
        items = items.filter(b => !set.has(b));
        items.push({ x0: s.px0, x1: s.x1, y: base, h: med, s: tex ? `\\sqrt{${R}}` : (simple(R) ? "√" + R : `√(${R})`), m: true });
      }
    }
  }


  // ---- vector-outlined glyphs (no text in the PDF): leave a visible marker next to the text they sit in
  if (shapes && shapes.glyphs && shapes.glyphs.length) {
    const gl = [...shapes.glyphs].sort((a, b) => a.x0 - b.x0), groups = [];
    for (const g of gl) { if (g.y1 - g.y0 > 1.1 * med || g.y1 - g.y0 < 0.25 * med || g.x1 - g.x0 > 1.1 * med || !items.some(b => !b.br && /[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(b.s) && Math.abs(b.y - g.y0) < 0.35 * med && g.x0 - b.x1 < 1.5 * med && b.x0 - g.x1 < 1.5 * med) || !items.some(b => !b.br && Math.abs(b.y - g.y0) < 0.8 * med && g.x0 - b.x1 < 1.5 * med && b.x0 - g.x1 < 1.5 * med)) continue;
      const q = groups.find(q => Math.abs(q.y - g.y0) < 0.5 * med && g.x0 - q.x1 < 0.5 * med); if (q) q.x1 = Math.max(q.x1, g.x1); else groups.push({ x0: g.x0, x1: g.x1, y: g.y0 }); }
    for (const q of groups) items.push({ x0: q.x0, x1: q.x1, y: q.y + 0.2, h: med, s: UNKNOWN });
  }
  // ---- matrices / determinants: big bracket pairs or vertical rules enclosing a grid of entries
  const rowsOf = bs => { const rs = []; for (const b of [...bs].sort((a, c) => c.y - a.y)) { const r = rs.find(r => Math.abs(r.y - b.y) < 0.45 * med); if (r) r.bs.push(b); else rs.push({ y: b.y, bs: [b] }); } return rs; };
  const cellsOf = r => { const cs = []; for (const b of r.bs.sort((a, c) => a.x0 - c.x0)) { const c = cs[cs.length - 1]; if (c && b.x0 - c.x1 < 0.9 * med) { c.bs.push(b); c.x1 = Math.max(c.x1, b.x1); } else cs.push({ bs: [b], x0: b.x0, x1: b.x1 }); } return cs; };
  const gridOf = bs => {
    const rs = rowsOf(bs); if (rs.length < 2) return null;
    const g = rs.map(r => cellsOf(r)); const nc = g[0].length; if (g.some(r => r.length !== nc)) return null;
    for (let k = 1; k < nc; k++) { const xs = g.map(r => r[k].x0); if (Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs) > 2.5 * med && g.length > 2) {/* loosely aligned: still accept */} }
    return g.map(r => r.map(c => join(c.bs)));
  };
  const fmtGrid = (grid, env) => tex ? `\\begin{${env}}${grid.map(r => r.join(" & ")).join(" \\\\ ")}\\end{${env}}` : (env === "vmatrix" ? "|" : env === "pmatrix" ? "(" : "[") + grid.map(r => r.join(" ")).join("; ") + (env === "vmatrix" ? "|" : env === "pmatrix" ? ")" : "]");
  const take = (bs, x0, x1, ylo, yhi) => bs.filter(b => !b.br && (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2 > x0 && (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2 < x1 && b.y + 0.35 * b.h >= ylo && b.y + 0.35 * b.h <= yhi);
  const asBox = (x0, x1, ylo, yhi, str) => ({ x0, x1, y: (ylo + yhi) / 2 - 0.35 * med, h: med, s: str, m: true });
  for (const o of brs.filter(c => "([".includes(c.ch)).sort((a, b) => (b.ymax - b.ymin) - (a.ymax - a.ymin))) {
    const cc = o.ch === "(" ? ")" : "]", c = brs.find(c => c.ch === cc && c.x0 > o.x1 && Math.abs(c.ymax - o.ymax) < 3 && Math.abs(c.ymin - o.ymin) < 3 && !c.used);
    if (!c || o.used) continue;
    const ylo = o.ymin - 3, yhi = o.ymax + 0.9 * med + 3, mem = take(items, o.x1 - 1, c.x0 + 1, ylo, yhi), grid = mem.length >= 2 ? gridOf(mem) : null;
    if (!grid) continue;
    o.used = c.used = true; const set = new Set(mem); items = items.filter(b => !set.has(b));
    items.push(asBox(o.x0, c.x1, o.ymin, o.ymax + med, fmtGrid(grid, o.ch === "(" ? "pmatrix" : "bmatrix")));
  }
  if (shapes && shapes.vbars) {
    const vs = [...shapes.vbars].sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
    for (let i = 0; i < vs.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < vs.length; j++) {
      const a = vs[i], b = vs[j]; if (a.used || b.used || b.x - a.x < 1.5 * med || b.x - a.x > 400 || Math.abs(a.y0 - b.y0) > 3 || Math.abs(a.y1 - b.y1) > 3) continue;
      const mem = take(items, a.x, b.x, a.y0, a.y1); if (mem.length < 4) continue;
      const g = gridOf(mem); if (!g || g[0].length < 2) continue;
      if (Math.min(...mem.map(m => m.x0)) - a.x > 2.5 * med || b.x - Math.max(...mem.map(m => m.x1)) > 2.5 * med) continue;     // rules far from the entries = table border
      a.used = b.used = true; const set = new Set(mem); items = items.filter(m => !set.has(m));
      items.push(asBox(a.x, b.x, a.y0, a.y1, fmtGrid(g, "vmatrix"))); break;
    }
  }

  // 3) place bracket boxes on the baseline of the content they enclose
  for (const c of brs) {
    if (c.used) continue;
    const open = "([{".includes(c.ch), cand = items.filter(b => !b.br && (open ? b.x0 >= c.x0 - 1 : b.x1 <= c.x1 + 1) && b.y + 0.35 * b.h >= c.ymin - 4 && b.y + 0.35 * b.h <= c.ymax + 14);
    if (!cand.length) continue;
    const t = cand.reduce((m, b) => { const d = open ? b.x0 - c.x0 : c.x1 - b.x1; return d < m.d ? { d, b } : m; }, { d: 1e9, b: null }).b;
    items.push({ x0: c.x0, x1: c.x1, y: t.y, h: med, s: c.ch, br: true });
  }
  return items;
}

// Row tidy-up: pull brackets into math islands, merge neighbouring $…$ islands joined only by operators/brackets.
export function tidy(t) {
  if (!t.includes("$")) return t;
  t = t.replace(/([(\[]+\s*)\$([^$]*)\$/g, (m, a, b) => `$${a.replace(/\s+/g, "")}${b}$`).replace(/\$([^$]*)\$(\s*[)\]]+)/g, (m, a, b) => `$${a}${b.replace(/\s+/g, "")}$`);
  t = t.replace(/(^|[^\\A-Za-z])(sin|cos|tan|cot|sec|cosec|log|ln)(?=\s*\$)/g, (m, p, f) => `${p}$${toTex(f).trim()}$`);
  t = t.replace(/\$([^$]*)\$((?:[A-Za-z0-9]{1,2})?\))(?![A-Za-z0-9])/g, (m, a, b) => `$${a}${b}$`);
  const OPS_ = String.raw`(?:\s*[=+\-−–<>≤≥≠±×÷·,.:;(\[\]∈∉⊂∪∩]|\s*\)(?!\s*[A-Za-z]?\))|\s+\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\s*[A-Za-zθαβγδπφω](?![A-Za-z)]))*\s*`;
  const RE = new RegExp(String.raw`\$([^$]+)\$(${OPS_})\$([^$]+)\$`, "g");
  for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
    const n = t.replace(RE, (m, a, op, b) => `$${a} ${toTex(op).trim()} ${b}$`);
    if (n === t) break; t = n;
  }
  t = t.replace(/\$([^$]*\\(?:int|iint|oint)[^$]*)\$(\s*)(d[a-zA-Zθ])(?![A-Za-z])/g, "$$$1\\,$3$$");
  return t.replace(/\$([^$]*)\$/g, (m, a) => "$" + a.replace(/\(\s+/g, "(").replace(/\s+\)/g, ")").replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim() + "$");
}
